newsitem.title: USA: Five dead in apparent murder-suicide in S. Calif..
newsitem.headline: Five dead in apparent murder-suicide in S. Calif..

text.p: An apparently despondent man shot and killed his wife and three children then apparently turned the gun on himself, police said on Tuesday.
Police in suburban Simi Valley were reportedly in tears as they removed the bodies of three boys all under the age of five from the family home.
A spokesman said detectives were investigating the early morning shootings, but were working on the theory it was a murder-suicide.
